verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own docs describe BugSnag On-premise as a self-hosted version of the product for organizations that want to manage their own data, deployable in existing PCI or HIPAA compliant environments. That is the core product, self-hosted. The evidence is a single summary-level doc line, though. Missing for 10: deployment and installation details, licensing or plan requirements for on-premise, feature parity with the SaaS version, independent or hands-on corroboration.
